effects.description: At most 16 effects, each at most 256 bytes.

operation_token.description: Canonical operation preview token, when the selected command requires one.

ActSubmit.description: Caller identity and executable admission fields are deliberately absent.

AgentActivity.description:
A session's recorded events counted per minute, oldest first. The last bucket is the
minute containing `until`; a quiet minute is zero.

until.description: The instant the buckets were counted at, RFC 3339.

activity.description:
Recorded events per minute over the last minutes (`agents.activity.v1`); absent
when the session has no timestamped record.

controls.description: What the owner may do to this session now. The client never infers these.

generation.description: The host generation the controls were computed for; a control command echoes it.

last_output_at.description:
When the session last produced recorded output, RFC 3339 (`agents.activity.v1`);
absent when the daemon cannot tell.

steps.description:
The session's own progress steps, in order (`agents.activity.v1`); absent when it
published none.

turn.description: The open turn, when the host reports one.

oneOf.description: Fenced by the owner: alive, taking no automated input until resumed.

AgentStep.description: One step of a session's published progress.

content.description:
UTF-8 text or one independently base64-encoded byte chunk.
The complete JSON-RPC reply remains within APP_CONTROL_MAX.

key.description: Canonical catalog key within that owner, not a filesystem path.

task.description: Canonical task or assistant artifact owner.

truncated.description: More source content exists; continue with DetailReply.next.

oneOf.description:
Fence the session: its host stays up and queued messages wait. An owner message or
`resume` lifts it.
Fenced by the owner: alive, queued messages wait until resumed.

command.description: A CLI hint, never permission to execute a command on the client.

runtime.description: RuntimeRef and machine identity do not exist on legacy run bindings.

BoardCursor.description:
`after = Some(id)` resumes within `rev`; None has consumed that whole revision.
The empty starting cursor is `{ rev: 0, after: None }`.

text.description: At most 60 Unicode scalar values in projector output.

age_since.description: CLI card age: current run start while Running, otherwise last task update.

attention.description: At most four unresolved attention ledger keys.

goal.description: At most 80 Unicode scalar values in projector output.

held_reason.description: Recorded hold reason, or the CLI's canonical owner-dispatch-hold cause.

last_event.description: Unknown until the store maintains a newest-owner-visible-event fact.

rail.description: Run, gate, review, land, in that order.

commits.description: At most 50, in stored order (newest last).

messages.description: At most the newest 100, chronological by timestamp instant; source order breaks ties.

BuildRow.description: A published build record, independent of task scheduling and statistics.

cwd.description: Raw `std::env::current_dir()`; None when unreadable or not UTF-8.

CallerEnv.description: Caller-identity variables, `None` = unset. Values are `to_string_lossy` of `var_os`.

total.description:
Exact owner-relevant totals, independent of page size and history cursor.
Unknown only when talking to an older daemon.

build.description: The client's build identity (what `corral build-identity` prints).

exe.description: Absolute path of the client's executable.

older.description: Opaque exclusive `before` anchor for the next older page, if any.

rows.description:
Most recently updated first, ties by task number descending; at most
CLOSED_PAGE_MAX rows.

total.description:
Exact count of closed tasks, independent of the requested anchor; None when the
daemon cannot count it without reading closed history.

updated.description: Last canonical update, RFC 3339: the list's order key, normally the closing change.

message.description: The error formatted with its full context chain (`format!("{err:#}")`).

exit.description: Process exit status the CLI uses: 0 for `done`, 1 otherwise.

output.description: None for `running`, `unknown`, `abandoned`, and replays without retained output.

abandon_if_absent.description: For an absent id, write an abandoned tombstone that refuses late submits.

wait_ms.description: Wait for an in-flight command, at most 25_000.

client_build.description: Required from local CLI clients; must equal the daemon's (`pm_read::client_identity`).

oneOf.description:
A family this build does not know; its `args`, if any, are skipped. A plain
`#[serde(other)]` unit arm of an adjacently tagged enum refuses non-null content.
Clone only a server-configured profile; never accepts host commands or raw TOML.

ControlState.description:
One control of a session: offered, or refused with a machine code such as `host_lost`,
`no_bridge`, `ended`, `not_owned`, `adopted_pane`, `not_paused`, `no_turn`.

oneOf.description: Closed tasks, newest first; `before` is a page's opaque `older` anchor.

body.description: None means not modified, not an empty or unavailable detail.

last_seen.description: Coarse RFC3339 time of authenticated activity, not an online indicator.

DevicePageQuery.description: App-safe device enumeration without changing the Unix device.list contract.

after.description: Resume strictly after this canonical device ID.

limit.description: At most DEVICE_PAGE_LIMIT_MAX; replies also obey APP_CONTROL_MAX.

accepts_text.description:
Submit `QuestionCommand::Answer` using this key/rev, owner=true and option=None.
False after settlement; old servers omit this capability.

revision.description: Canonical PM inbox revision used by pm.inbox-withdraw, not ThreadEntry.rev.

bytes.description: Whole canonical content length in UTF-8 bytes at this revision.

complete.description: No more content will be appended. All `total` parts must still be collected.

id.description: Semantic message ID; answers use the live stream's `<message>/answer/0` anchor.

index.description: Zero-based transport part position, independent of page boundaries.

oneOf.description: Catalog reference only; bytes use the bounded Artifact detail reader.
Refuse with `conflict` unless `corral_core::owner_revision(task)` still equals `revision`.

FileInput.description: A file named on the command line, read by the client before routing.

path.description: Path as typed (`Path::display()`), for messages only.

device.description: Recorded device name; absent for pane-typed input.

id.description: Canonical filed owner input, stable across retries and quick-thread rolls.

session.description: Source assistant session, including ended quick-thread generations.

newer.description: Exclusive `before` anchor for the next newer page; None selects newest.

older.description: Exclusive `before` anchor for the next older page, if any.

rows.description: Newest first; at most FILINGS_PAGE_MAX summaries.

total.description: Exact count of chat filings, independent of the requested `before` anchor.

attention.description: Canonical next mover and blocker; absent only for older producers.

LiveText.description: UTF-8 text offset in bytes; acknowledged pages advance the running turn.

last_pass_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, absent before the first completed pass.

completed.description:
True only after a full pass that started after receipt of this nudge completed
within the requested wait. Finishing an already-running pass does not qualify.

OutputBody.description: Exactly `frames` DATA frames follow on `stream`: one UTF-8 JSON `CmdOutput`, `bytes` long.

candidate.description: Present for candidate-bound review patches; absent on plan diffs and older daemons.

patch.description: At most 48 KiB; remaining text is fetched with DetailReply.next.

notes.description: Canonical explicit decision resolutions retained by the acceptance guard.

linked.description: Published tracker for a design, or approved source design for a tracker.

owner_decisions.description: Exact canonical decision texts requiring explicit owner acceptance resolutions.

revisions.description: Canonical submitted revision IDs in stored order, including unreviewed revisions.

role.description: Canonical record kind; absent only when the producer does not know it.

oneOf.description: A known ordinary task, not an unknown record kind.

linked.description: Published tracker for a design, or approved source design for a tracker.

projects.description: Distinct projects of the plan's member tasks, sorted; empty when no member names one.

role.description: Canonical record kind; absent only when the producer does not know it.

oneOf.description: No submitted revision is waiting for the owner; planning or changes remain.
A submitted document still needs independent review or automatic processing.
Planning or its review failed or escalated, not an acceptance request.
A submitted, unapproved document is waiting for the owner's decision.
The document is accepted; a design may already have published its tracker.
What clients send; the daemon replaces it from the transport.
Reserved for paired devices; refused on the Unix socket.

ProfileChoice.description: A configured profile's safe editable values and canonical removal restrictions.

inherited.description: Removing the workspace entry would leave a personal or built-in profile.

references.description: Current configured/task/session references, for explanation rather than authority.

remove_refusal.description: None only when canonical removal is currently possible; rechecked at commit.

summary_refusal.description: A configured profile may be unsuitable for an independent quick-thread summary request.

workspace.description: A workspace entry exists, including partial overrides of inherited profiles.

connection.description: Empty only for legacy senders or an unknown connection.

ProjectRow.description:
One configured project of the workspace (`Topic::Projects`, `projects.v1`). A complete
empty page means the workspace has no project management: no board work, PM off.

autopilot.description: Whether an active autopilot grant names this project.

id.description: Configuration key; the identity tasks reference in `project`.

in_pm_scope.description: Whether the workspace PM's approved scope includes this project.

needs_me.description: Open owner-attention items for this project's tasks.

open.description: Tasks that are neither done nor dropped.

path.description: Workspace-relative path when inside the workspace, otherwise absolute.

running.description: Open tasks with a live worker session.

evidence.description: At most five blocks, each bounded to 8 KiB by the reader.

consequence_derived.description: At least one consequence field was inferred from canonical task dependencies.

consequence_missing.description: No option-specific consequence was recorded or safely derived.

evidence.description: Zero-based index into this detail's evidence blocks.

endpoint.description: WebSocket base URL, without an application path or credentials.

ReadReply.description:
The response to `read`. Exactly `frames` Data frames follow it on `stream`, carrying `bytes` bytes of
one UTF-8 JSON document, in order, with nothing else written to the connection in between.

as_of.description: RFC 3339 time the document was computed.

cached.description: True when an earlier computation was reused.

seq.description: Store change sequence the document was computed at.

build.description: The client's build identity (what `corral build-identity` prints).

exe.description: Absolute path of the client's executable.

Response.description: A response has exactly one result or error. A successful null result is preserved.

ReviewCandidate.description: Immutable identity of the coding candidate whose patch is being displayed.

gates.description: Canonical gate receipts, independent of human or agent reviewer verdicts.

ReviewGate.description:
A run's latest gate receipt, retained even when it checked an older candidate.
`by` names its recorded commands; `text` contains failure or stale diagnostics.
Combined canonical output remains available in `ReviewDetail::gate_log_tail`.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds, as in the host fleet journal.

text.description: At most 2,048 Unicode characters; oldest entries are removed to fit a page.

SessionChild.description: Bounded app projection; no child instructions, transcripts, reports or paths.

verdict.description: `approve` or `changes` when a review child records its verdict.

oneOf.description: Cancel a turn of a live host, as Esc does in its terminal. The session stays live.

generation.description: Refuse with `conflict` unless this is still the host's generation.

turn.description: Turn sequence to cancel (default: the current turn).

oneOf.description: Cancel the current turn and fence the session against automated input until `resume`.
Lift a pause; input queued meanwhile is delivered in order.
Stop the host and end the session. A task keeps its worktree and waits in Needs me.
Fence a lost host and start the next generation of the same session.

replace.description: Replace a host that is still alive after verifying its identity.

oneOf.description: Open the PM when none is live.
Owner words typed into the session. Lifts a pause.

policy.description: `steer` or `follow-up`: what a busy host does with the words.

oneOf.description:
Keys, then optional text, typed into the session's pane. Only for a session with a pane
and no host bridge.

SessionControls.description: Per-session controls, computed by the daemon. A default value offers nothing.

keys.description: Keys typed into the session's pane.

relaunch.description: Start the next generation of a lost host (for the PM row: open the PM).

send.description: Owner words into the session's chat.

stop.description: Terminate: stop the host and end the session.

take_over.description: Move a pane-hosted assistant into the daemon.

messages.description: Newest at most 100 entries, in journal order.

messages_total.description: Includes messages removed by journal retention and page byte bounds.

arguments.description: Pretty JSON, not a flattened argument description.

call.description: Original call metadata, including argument validation errors and namespaces.

result.description: Complete structured result, including images and presenter-specific details.

oneOf.description: All persisted fields read by an extension presenter, without reducing them to prose.
Immediately follows the preview it replaces. Fetch and concatenate JSON fragments.

json.description: A UTF-8 fragment of the complete serialized SessionItem.

SessionLiveEvent.description:
Text/thinking offsets are UTF-8 bytes, independent per (generation, turn, message,
kind). Applying chunks at their offsets, rather than appending, is idempotent.

oneOf.description: The optional page-level fleet is a current replacement, not a turn delta.

SessionLiveGap.description:
Drop the live overlay and reconcile from `detail.get { session }`. A zero
`missing` still signals discontinuity (generation change or unavailable host).

profiles.description: Exact configured profiles, separate from assistant-compatible model choices.

rows.description: A health page contains the single current snapshot.

oneOf.description: Pushed on topic `classic` when the daemon's frame revision passes the subscriber's cursor.

as_of.description: RFC 3339 time of the recompute that produced `rev`.

epoch.description: This daemon process's frame series; any other value means resubscribe.

rev.description: Strictly increasing within `epoch`; bumps only when frame content changed.

seq.description: Store change sequence the frame was checked through.

oneOf.description: One bounded page in flight; `left` contains removed row IDs.

fleet.description: Current fleet replacement for capable clients; omission means no current fleet.

snapshot.description: Complete bounded replacement window; absent on an unavailable pane.

owner_revision.description: The canonical owner revision, never a projection row revision.

park_revision.description: Revision of the active canonical park, for revision-bound unpark actions.

TerminalColor.description:
A terminal colour: an index into the 256-colour palette (0-15 are the client's theme
colours), or a 24-bit `[red, green, blue]`.

TerminalRun.description:
Consecutive cells of one terminal row that share a style. An absent colour is the terminal's
default for that ground; the client owns the defaults and the indexed palette.

inverse.description: Foreground and background swapped (SGR 7), resolved by the client against its defaults.

lines.description:
Latest bounded scrollback plus screen, in display order. Stream pages replace this
window, never append repeated screen rows. Recorded gates remain non-live captures.

rows.description:
The same lines as styled runs, one row per line, when the source carries styling (a live
pane's screen); empty otherwise. A row's run texts concatenate to its line.

completion.description: Canonical host settlement, never inferred from a Stop request or a generic done stream.

cost_usd.description: One semantic answer's amount, carried only by part zero. None means unknown, never zero.

part.description: Absent on older servers; continuation IDs remain readable as legacy transport parts.

typed_at.description: Original owner-typed RFC 3339 time; `at` remains the canonical receipt/order time.

UsageCompleteness.description:
Scan coverage accompanies every monetary/token total, including known subtotals.
The scanned instants are the earliest/latest dated facts examined, not proof
that every record between them was examined. `partial` covers omitted records.

UsageQuota.description:
Provider evidence is not a numerical allowance. An exhaustion observation can
name a reset while its limit, consumption and headroom remain unknown.
